modules.title: Python Basics
modules.content: Python functions are reusable blocks of code used to perform specific tasks. Functions improve readability and modularity. Lists can be processed using loops.
modules.practice_question: Write a Python function to create a list containing squares of elements from a given list.

modules.title: List Comprehension
modules.content: List comprehension provides concise syntax for creating and transforming lists in Python. It improves readability and reduces lines of code.
modules.practice_question: Write a Python function using list comprehension to return cubes of elements from a list.
